title: Circuit Shuffle: A Rooftop Rhapsody
logline: A shy robot overcomes its social anxiety to find joy and self-expression on the dance floor at a vibrant rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-acceptance, finding joy in new experiences

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, metallic robot with expressive LED eyes, initially shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Luna
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant and friendly human partygoer with an infectious smile, who encourages Bolt.

scenes.title: Rooftop Arrival
scenes.summary: Bolt, a small, metallic robot, arrives hesitantly at a vibrant rooftop party, looking overwhelmed by the dancing crowd and loud music.
scenes.setting: A lively rooftop party at dusk, city lights twinkling in the background. Upbeat electronic music plays.

scenes.title: Observing the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Bolt stands awkwardly near the edge of the party, observing energetic partygoers dancing freely, his LED eyes reflecting a mix of curiosity and longing.
scenes.setting: The same rooftop party, closer view of the dance floor with various people enjoying themselves.

scenes.title: A Friendly Invitation
scenes.summary: Luna, noticing Bolt's solitude, approaches with a warm smile and extends a hand, inviting him to join the dance. Bolt's internal circuits whir with indecision.
scenes.setting: The edge of the dance floor, a slightly quieter spot where Bolt is standing.
scenes.mood: Encouraging, friendly, hopeful, a touch of apprehension from Bolt

scenes.title: First Steps on the Floor
scenes.summary: Bolt, encouraged by Luna, takes stiff, mechanical steps onto the dance floor. Luna gently guides him, showing him simple, repetitive moves. Bolt's movements are initially jerky.
scenes.setting: The heart of the dance floor, surrounded by other dancers, under soft, pulsing lights.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: As the music swells, Bolt's movements become smoother, more fluid. He starts to mimic Luna's moves, then adds his own unique, joyful robot flair, his LED eyes glowing brightly with newfound confidence.
scenes.setting: The center of the dance floor, under flashing, colorful lights, other partygoers smiling at Bolt.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
